topic: Agents can skip the git hooks with --no-verify
detail: SP-045's hooks run for every commit and push in a repository, but git commit --no-verify and git push --no-verify skip them (git -c core.hooksPath=... is already refused by SP-044's check). Proposed: while a checkout has orch's hooks installed, the tool hook's outbound check refuses --no-verify (and -n for commit) on git commit, push and merge in agent sessions, so only the user's own terminal can skip them.
